question: Who among the following is the first Indian to win gold at Junior World Weightlifting Championship in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harshada Sharad Garud**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Harshada Sharad Garud** became the first Indian to win a gold medal at the Junior World Weightlifting Championship in May 2022.
 
• She achieved this historic feat in the **women's 45 kg category**.
 
• Harshada lifted a total of **153 kg** (70 kg in snatch and 83 kg in clean and jerk).
 
• This accomplishment has made her a significant figure in Indian weightlifting, inspiring many young athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Weightlifting** is a sport in which athletes attempt to lift heavy weights mounted on steel bars called barbells. The two main events in weightlifting are the **snatch** and the **clean and jerk**.
 
• **Snatch**: The lift in which the weight is lifted from the ground to overhead in one continuous motion.
 
• **Clean and Jerk**: The lift in which the weight is first lifted to the shoulders (clean) and then from the shoulders to overhead (jerk).
 
• **Junior World Weightlifting Championship**: An annual event organized by the International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) where junior athletes (under 20 years of age) from around the world compete.
 
• India has a growing history in weightlifting, with several athletes achieving international success, bringing recognition and honor to the country.
